data.gender_notes: Jhanakavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jhanakavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jhanana' which means 'to delight'. The name is often used for girls in Hindu tradition, symbolizing joy, happiness, and delight. The name Jhanakavi carries the meaning “Joyful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jhanakavi usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jhanakavi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
